title: E0059: Dynamic eval or assert
plain_english: `eval()` executes a string as PHP code. A string-based `assert()` can also execute code. If any part of that code comes from untrusted input, it can lead to code execution.
why_matters: Executing code built at runtime is difficult to validate safely and can turn data into executable behavior.
what_it_checks: `assert()` with a string literal or string concatenation
